forum.title: STM32WBA5M (Module) UltraLib Footprint error
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Juanduino and welcome to the community;

The requests about Ultralibrarian models must be handled directly through "Model feedback". To give your feedback, I recommend you to click on [this link](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wba5mmg.html#cad-resources) and follow the below steps.

![KDJEM1_0-1776071069993.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/01d7189e-7fb9-e31d-341f-8defb95cdf54.png "KDJEM1_0-1776071069993.png")

![KDJEM1_1-1776071094841.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/7b1a563d-25f1-fe51-9b2e-d88adff7d1f5.png "KDJEM1_1-1776071094841.png")

Thank you.

Kaouthar
forum.content_text:
Dear sir / madam

The UltraLibrarian WBA5M (Module) footprint is flawed. Potentially it can screw the module under reflow.

Those center GND pads are not placed correct. I noticed when comparing the ST dev-board module.

see image..![STM32WBA5M (Module) UltraLibrarian CenterGND pads skew.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/3ce05bad-138e-61bb-fa35-fe0b4688849a.jpg "STM32WBA5M (Module) UltraLibrarian CenterGND pads skew.jpg")
